name: Mandible
description: The Mandible was an Imperial starship that was involved in an accident by 3 ABY, when the vessel's captain ferried vaporous cargo aboard the ship while drunk. As a result, an emissary to the Imperial Ruling Council, Everi Chalis, punished the crew of the Mandible during the Belnar Insurrections and cited these punishments later on when pressuring the crew of a heavy freighter into changing course.
